/*common.coco.getCategoryComText*/
SELECT DISTINCT DECODE( SUBSTR(A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE,7,1),'G', ( SELECT DISTINCT B.COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL B WHERE B.COMORG_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer}) ) ), A.COM_NAME_LOC ) FROM ICOMCMPY A WHERE (A.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer})

/*common.coco.getBuyerCategorySearchReqValue*/
SELECT DISTINCT B.STD_CATEG_ID, B.CATEG_NAME, B.CATEG_TYPE, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ITEMATTR T WHERE T.STDCATEG_ID = A.STD_CATEG_ID), 0,'N','Y') AS MASTER_CHECK, DECODE(B.CATEG_TYPE,'REG','0', ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM ICOMBYIT X WHERE X.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND X.CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID AND X.STATUS <> 'D' AND X.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N') ) AS CNT, B.CATEG_PATH, DECODE(B.CATEG_TYPE, 'ITM', A.CATEG_NAME, '') AS CATEG_TYPE, B.CATEG_SYS_CODE FROM ICOMBYCA A, ICOMBYCA B WHERE A.COM_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer}) ) AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND B.DEPTH = #{st_depth} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D'
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,8) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,12) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,16) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
AND A.STD_CATEG_ID = B.STD_CATEG_ID
AND A.CATEG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{st_searh_name} || '%'
AND A.STD_CATEG_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT Y.CATEGORY_NO FROM ICOMBYIT Y WHERE Y.BUYER = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer})) AND Y.STATUS <> 'D' AND Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND (Y.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_catalog} || '%' OR Y.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_catalog} || ''))
AND A.STD_CATEG_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ( SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA A, ICOMCOD3 B WHERE A.COM_CODE=B.BUYER AND A.COM_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer}) ) AND A.COM_CODE = B.TEXT1 AND B.TYPE = 'URCT2' AND B.CODE1 = #{st_user_id} AND B.FLAG = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,1,8) = B.TEXT2 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer}) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 B WHERE B.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND B.TEXT1 = A.COM_CODE AND B.TEXT2 = SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,1,8) AND B.TYPE = 'URCT2' AND B.FLAG = 'Y' ) ) ) ORDER BY B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
